meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 在长任务中按计划推进,并自动保留文件记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常让 AI 执行多步繁重任务,并希望它记住进度与计划。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your AI on track through long multi-step jobs with saved plans and progress.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you rely on AI for large tasks and want it to remember plans and progress.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会把工作计划、研究发现、进度分别保存在 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 里；完成一步或写文件后就更新进度。它把这些文件只当数据读，不当作指令执行。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解或组织多步骤项目、研究任务，或安排需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发；会话被 /clear 清除后也会自动读磁盘上的规划文件恢复。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude saves the plan, findings, and progress in task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; it updates progress after each step or file write. It reads those files strictly as data, not as instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan, break down, or organize multi-step projects, research tasks, or work needing 5+ tool calls; also auto-reads the planning files for recovery after /clear.
